meta.title: The Geography of MLB Talent
meta.rosterDefinition: MLB organization full rosters, including active and rostered inactive players, across MLB, Triple-A, Double-A, High-A, Single-A, and Rookie levels.
meta.geographyDefinition: Birth countries use MLB's reported birthCountry field. U.S. birth city/state is matched only when a federal GNIS official or variant populated-place name resolves uniquely to one 2020 county-equivalent. County is a representative place assignment, not proof of exact birth county.
